# A32-S06: Correspondence

Edited source text. [████] marks omissions.

Thought so too – I'm booking

Do you remember I told you about [████], where they really wanted to come out to the hub and hear about The Synthetic Party and LederLars?
Of course, it's located at [████] Sigh.
Just had a meeting with them, and trying to move our meeting [████] to [████]. Otherwise, it will be [████] and [████], who could possibly run the show and talk about [████]’s work and chat with LederLars. I hope we can move it – I said that we'll come back with the newest knowledge and be able to go all out. They said that [████] signed up because of LederLars...

It is also a pity to miss that network!! It is right down our alley…
